name: Grok ATR mean Reversion
description:
Rules, evaluated on closed 5-minute bars only:
Trend: fast EMA(20) above slow EMA(50) for longs; the reverse for shorts. Price must also be on the correct side of EMA(20).
Pullback entry: in an uptrend, RSI(14) dips to 40 or below, then closes back above 40 while the bar closes above EMA(20). Mirror for shorts (RSI tags 60+, then closes back below 60).
Volatility filter: skip the bar if ATR(14) is below its 50-bar median (dead market) or the bar range is more than 2.5× ATR (news spike).
Risk: stop at 1.5× ATR from entry. Take profit at 2.5× ATR (about 1.67R). Move stop to breakeven after 1R.
Session: only trade a defined session (default 09:35–15:45 exchange time). Flatten at session end. One position at a time. Cooldown of 3 bars after an exit
